svg.text: FERROSIFT / ENGINEERING
Installation envelope and trial gates
Layout reservations, ideal kinematics and tests still needed / no rated machine performance
CONCEPT ONLY
NOT FOR FABRICATION
PLAN / 900 mm side zones from outer equipment / 1:40
SERVICE SPACE IS A RESERVATION
Measure side zones from the outer hardware envelope, including projecting cabinet or drive parts. Door, cassette-withdrawal and bin-exchange sweeps need
separate site checks. End access, utilities and actual dust-control connections remain to be designed.
FEED BOUNDARY
Only depolluted, liberated, dry screened WEEE. Run 12.5-25 and 25-50 mm campaigns separately. Exclude batteries, whole devices, hazards, tangles and
oversized/heavy pieces; sieve size does not bound length, thickness or mass.
IDEAL KINEMATICS
m/s
mm/frame*
s to lip**
* At 30 fps reference. ** 1250 mm / speed. Assumes steady belt speed, no slip or
collision. These are calculated values, not latency or throughput evidence.
PROPOSED TEST RAMP
50-200 kg/h is an experimental ramp, not rated capacity. Begin slow and sparse at 0.5
m/s; 1 m/s is the calculation reference and 2 m/s is an unvalidated study case.
MEASURE BEFORE CLAIMING
Calibrated sensor coverage and lift-off; presentation/overlap; synchronized
tracking/latency; ejection scatter and neighbours; chute dwell and gate feedback;
balanced mass, purity, recovery and actual buyer value.
SEPARATE EXISTING EVIDENCE
The recorded steel/copper YOLO demo remains a separate artifact. It is not PCB
inference, physical recovery or evidence of this concept's profitability.
DIMENSIONS: mm | SCALE: PER VIEW AT A3 | DO NOT SCALE FOR MANUFACTURE
Preliminary study geometry. Proposed inspection targets on sheet 8 are unapproved; no load, sensing or safety rating.
